what.text: This page follows refugees from Cameroon living in Nigeria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 107701 Cameroonian refugees in Nigeria, 76.7% of all refugees from Cameroon.
Nigeria is by far the largest host, followed by Chad, the United States and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Ambazonia territory in Cameroon from 2017 to 2025, with Ambazonia insurgents.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Cameroon with JAS in 2020 and from 2022 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group in several years from 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1993 at 18 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, in the same years as these conflicts, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Nigeria.
These are year-end totals for Nigeria only, reported to UNHCR.
